answer.rationale: A work-related fatality at a recordkeeping-covered establishment triggers the general recording criteria (1904.7(a)) and the requirement to record the case as work-related and new (1904.4(a)). It must be logged on the OSHA 300/301 within 7 calendar days (1904.29(b)(3)), reported to OSHA within 8 hours (1904.39(a)(1)), and records retained for 5 years (1904.33(a)). No PSM, LOTO, or HAZCOM triggers are indicated since no chemical process, energy control, or hazard communication facts are present in the scenario.
